family: One fixed total family f_n:{0,1}^n->{0,1}, defined uniformly for every integer n>=1 with no advice and no per-length choice, as the Ben-Sasson-Kopparty construction with p=2 (Theorem 2.2 of 'Affine Dispersers from Subspace Polynomials', preprint of 2010-03-12, journal version SIAM J. Comput. 41(4):880-914, 2012), instantiated exactly as fixed in proof.md Section 2 and disperser.md: f_0(empty)=0; for n>=1 let k be the least prime with k>2*n^(3/5), r=ceil(n/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); let q_k be the monic irreducible polynomial of degree k over F_2 returned by the fixed deterministic Shoup algorithm, K=F_2[Z]/(q_k) with F_2-basis 1,Z,...,Z^(k-1); let phi:F_2^n->K^r be the injective F_2-linear map that splits x into consecutive k-bit blocks (last block zero-padded) and reads each block in that basis, and let pi:K->F_2 be the constant-coefficient functional (nontrivial, pi(1)=1); put y_i=phi_i(x)^(2^(i+1)-1) for i=1..r and f_n(x)=pi(Sym_r^t(y_1,...,y_r)), where Sym_r^t is the t-th elementary symmetric polynomial. Every object in this definition is a deterministic function of n alone.
theorem: For this one fixed total family, which one fixed polynomial-time evaluator computes at every length and which is therefore in NP with the empty witness (witness bound zero, both directions proved), the following hold in the full Li-Yang B2 model, i.e. deterministic acyclic one-output circuits with two input pins per gate over all 16 binary truth tables, unbounded depth and fan-out, exact computation on every input, each retained gate counted once and inputs, wires and output selection costing nothing: every B2 circuit C computing f_n satisfies |C| >= (31/10)*n - (261/10)*d(n) - 128/5, where d(n)=floor(6*n^(4/5))+1 is the affine-disperser dimension of f_n, and d(n)/n tends to 0. Hence for every real epsilon>0 there is an integer N_epsilon such that for EVERY integer n>=N_epsilon, C_B2(f_n) >= (31/10-epsilon)*n. Therefore liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/n >= 31/10, so the declared pair is exactly (coefficient, exponent) = (31/10, 1). Nothing stronger is asserted: no coefficient above 31/10, no exponent above 1, no logarithmic factor and no lane or global endpoint is claimed anywhere in this submission.
